simple.meaning: לְבָנָא (Lᵉbânâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Lebana or Lebanah , one of the Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לְבָנָא (H3838) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:45, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לְבָנָא (H3838) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לְבָנָא (H3838) before moving outward to related references.
